row: fewer cells of the relevant lineage
compatible_observation: PV-positive count 44 percent lower in the whole hippocampus of the global knockout at 2 weeks (P01); sIPSC frequency and amplitude lower in the neuron-targeted model (C05)
competing_alternative: same counts if the cells exist but do not carry PV (A2) or are not yet PV-positive (A3); lower sIPSC amplitude does not need fewer cells (A4, A7)
discriminating_measure: per animal: density of a lineage-agnostic GABAergic marker (Gad1 mRNA, a second lineage marker such as Lhx6 or SST) with NeuN and nuclear density, same sections as PV; early cleaved-caspase or lineage-reporter counts only if the model carries the reporter
conditional_pharmacological_consequence: if lineage density is lower, an interneuron-level modulator acts on fewer cells and a rescue framing of the interneuron needs the circuit-level alternative; none follows without the count

compatible_observation: count and GAD65/67 down (P01, P06); pooled Pvalb and Kcnc1 transcript lower with Gad1 and Lhx6 not lower, one pool (B01)
competing_alternative: fewer cells (A1); delayed onset of the Pvalb program (A3)
discriminating_measure: Pvalb mRNA and PV protein intensity per Gad1-positive cell; fraction of Gad1-positive cells lacking PV; distribution, not mean
conditional_pharmacological_consequence: if cells are present with low PV, a functional probe in fast-spiking cells is meaningful; it tests function, it does not show that expression is restored

compatible_observation: P13 to 17 is the window in which the PV program and nets form (R01); immature-neuron markers higher and oligodendrocyte lineage lower in one pool (B01, B02)
competing_alternative: A1 and A2 at a fixed age
discriminating_measure: at least two ages inside the viable window (P14 and P17), fast-spiking firing and spike width of recorded cells, PV and net readouts in the same animals
conditional_pharmacological_consequence: a single-age drug test cannot separate rescue from acceleration; age becomes a factor of any probe

compatible_observation: interneuron action potential amplitude lower, firing not different, 6 cells from 5 animals against 5 from 4 (C13, C14); pyramidal neurons more depolarised
discriminating_measure: identified fast-spiking cells (post-hoc PV staining of filled cells or reporter): action potential shape, firing, Kv3-sensitive component, in cortex L2/3
conditional_pharmacological_consequence: a Kv3 modulator is a candidate only if a Kv3-dependent deficit is seen in identified cells; otherwise no rationale

compatible_observation: excitatory amplitude up onto pyramidal cells (C03); nothing recorded onto interneurons
discriminating_measure: sEPSC and mEPSC onto identified fast-spiking cells, genotype by genotype
conditional_pharmacological_consequence: a global increase of excitation is not selective potentiation of interneurons; an excitatory-input modulator is a hypothesis with a different condition and a seizure risk

compatible_observation: sIPSC frequency lower (C05); mIPSC not recorded (C04)
discriminating_measure: mIPSC with TTX in a low-chloride internal; paired recordings of identified fast-spiking cell to pyramidal cell (success rate, unitary amplitude, failures, paired-pulse ratio)
conditional_pharmacological_consequence: release-side modulators only if release is shown lower; not a ground for a postsynaptic agent

compatible_observation: amplitude about halved (C05) and the authors' own wording for glutamatergic currents only (C03)
competing_alternative: A1 to A6; the high-chloride internal and unnamed isolation change driving force and mix currents (C06, C07)
discriminating_measure: mIPSC amplitude and agonist-evoked GABA-A current, low-chloride internal, antagonists named, chloride gradient measured in the same cell type
conditional_pharmacological_consequence: a GABA-A positive modulator needs a postsynaptic deficit and a known chloride gradient at this age; neither is shown, and the chloride gradient is not inferred from these recordings

compatible_observation: all of the above are compatible with the rows read; the global-knockout counts (hippocampus), the conditional currents (cortex) and the pooled transcripts (hippocampus) are three systems, not replicates
discriminating_measure: factorial reading of A1 to A7 on the same animals before any probe
conditional_pharmacological_consequence: reasoned abstention on a drug class; a non-cell-autonomous defect can still be probed functionally, so cell-autonomy is not required, but the probe must say which row it tests
